item.title: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Comisma Plan 10 Billion Yen Anime Production Fund
item.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank and IP platform company Comisma have agreed in principle to establish an investment fund focused on anime production, targeting 10 billion yen (approximately US$63.4 million) in assets under management by the end of fiscal 2027.
